There is a pervasive lie that Hamas agreed to disarm as part of the Gaza deal. No such agreement was signed by Hamas. This is a total fabrication used to justify Israel’s attempt to continue its ethic cleansing operations and to obtain a “surrender” it failed to achieve in war.

Israel isn’t even bothering to pretend these officials are attacking Israeli forces or engaged in an imminent operation. Israel just cites “October 7” revenge as though this is some clause in the “ceasefire” deal it signed.

In a sea of repeated ceasefire violations by Israel against Gaza, it remains important to note that Israel signed a ceasefire deal with *Hamas* yet continues to openly assassinate  and attempts to assassinate Hamas officials and commanders, in addition to killing civilians daily.

🔺Regarding Trump's demand that several nations join the so-called Abraham Accords as part of a potential Iran deal, an Iranian official tells me, "These issues have no connection whatsoever to the ceasefire negotiations between us and the Americans. 

"From our perspective, he is attempting to extract last-minute concessions from the Arab countries in the final stages of concluding the interim agreement."
